Highlights of 2023
paragraphs: Highlights of 2023

sections.text: Alpine vegetation with Milky Way in the background. Sunrise, Mount Rainier National Park, WashingtonWhat a remarkable year it has been! As I reflect on 2023, I am filled with gratitude for the experiences that enriched both my technical knowledge and personal growth.
